queries.name: top customers by sales
queries.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS total_sales
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT :limit_val;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS total_sales
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;

queries.name: top customer sales by region
queries.sql:
SELECT c.country, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS total_sales
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT :limit_val;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT c.country, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS total_sales
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5;

queries.name: sales per month on categories on a year
queries.sql:
SELECT 
    o.order_date::date AS order_month,
    SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    products p
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN 
    order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
JOIN 
    orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE 
    c.category_name IN :category_names
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = :year
GROUP BY 
    o.order_date::date
ORDER BY 
    o.order_date::date;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT 
    o.order_date::date AS order_month,
    SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    products p
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN 
    order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
JOIN 
    orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE 
    c.category_name IN ('Beverages', 'Confections', 'Seafood')
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 1997
GROUP BY 
    o.order_date::date
ORDER BY 
    o.order_date::date;
